Fallout 2 SuperCoop - quick start
=================================

Play Fallout 2 with the Restoration Project, together. One PC runs a server
that owns the world; everyone (the host too) joins it with their own
character.

YOU NEED
- Fallout 2 from Steam or GOG (US 1.02d), installed.
- Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit.
- About 2 GB of free disk space. The installer downloads the Restoration
  Project (827 MB) unless you put rpu_v2.4.34.zip next to install.cmd.
- For playing over the internet: a VPN such as ZeroTier or Tailscale.

INSTALL (everyone)
1. Extract this zip anywhere.
2. Double-click install.cmd and answer its questions (Enter takes the
   default). It finds your Fallout 2, builds a separate co-op folder next to
   it, installs the Restoration Project and makes two desktop shortcuts.
   Your original game is not touched.

HOST
1. Double-click "Fallout 2 SuperCoop - Host". First time: press Enter for a
   new game at the Temple of Trials. After that, Enter continues the newest
   save. Leave this window open.
2. Double-click "Fallout 2 SuperCoop - Join", pick a character name and
   leave the address empty.
3. Give your friends your VPN address (ZeroTier/Tailscale IP).

JOIN
Double-click "Fallout 2 SuperCoop - Join", pick a character name (the same
one every time - it IS your character) and enter the host's address.

UPDATING
Extract the new version and run install.cmd again, pointing at the same
co-op folder. It replaces the program files and keeps your saves.
Everyone in a game must run the same version.

KEYS
T chat - TAB automap - F6/F7 quicksave/quickload (rewinds everyone) -
talk to a player to trade - use a dead player to revive them.
Restoration Project Party Orders: H holster, F heal, G loot, R regroup,
X spread out, Ctrl+B ammo type (T is chat in co-op; rebind its pick-up key
in mods\party_orders.ini).

SAFETY
Never forward port 9300 to the internet: the game has no password. Use a VPN.
To stop the server: press F6 in game to quicksave, then close the server window.

TROUBLESHOOTING
Logs: f2_server-debug.log (server) and debug.log (client) in the co-op folder.
